segments.name: banking operations
segments.description: Red River Bank's banking operations, providing lending, deposit and treasury management services to commercial and retail customers across Louisiana markets.
segments.evidence: Accordingly, all of the Company's banking operations are considered by management to be aggregated in one reportable operating segment.

revenueModel.text: Commercial and retail customers pay the Bank for loans, deposits, treasury management and related banking services.
revenueModel.evidence: Through our wholly owned subsidiary, Red River Bank, a Louisiana state-chartered bank, we provide a fully integrated suite of banking products and services tailored to the needs of our commercial and retail customers.
